'''Cadrin Awel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] who was romantically linked to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. As a teenager, Awel performed as a [[Musician/Legends|singer]] but was unable to make an impact on the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after winning local contests on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Awel and her family hid on Vandor-3 to evade notice from the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Before the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Awel established a boot camp on Vandor-3 for people to learn nature skills. Her relationship with Thaal went undocumented and she was last recorded as having [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a fellow wartime survivor in [[42 ABY]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
